critical_code_review_comments: OpenCV.js auto-crop implementation is robust - uses Canny edge detection with multiple threshold sets for document detection
Perspective transform correctly straightens skewed documents
File import correctly passes autoCrop=true to worker
Worker initialization waits for cv.Mat and cv.findContours to be available before setting cvReady=true
Safety bounds (30%-95% of original area) prevent over/under-cropping
